headline: German Bank to Fund Feasibility Studies for Bogota Metro Line 4
summary: A German bank will provide funding to structure the feasibility studies for Bogota Metro Line 4, spanning from Street 100 to Street 235 along Autopista Norte.
why: Urban mass transit infrastructure financing facilitates long-term municipal development and construction procurement.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Financing for metro structuring advances capital infrastructure development.
